title: Patterns
examples: Teacher, how do I find the next shape?
Can we make a pattern with toys?
What is the rule for this colour pattern?

explain.say: Look at these shapes. First a circle, then a square.
Repeat them to make a pattern: circle, square, circle, square. This is a repeating pattern.
Patterns can use colours too: red, blue, red, blue. The colours repeat.
Look at green, yellow, green, yellow. The next colour is green again.
Look at this pattern again. Circle, square, circle, square. What comes after the last square?
Patterns help you know what comes next. The days of the week repeat. Monday comes after Sunday.

faq.q: How do I know which colour comes next?
faq.a: Look at the pattern before it. If it goes red, blue, red, blue, the next colour is red.
asks: Can you tell me the next colour?

faq.q: Do patterns always repeat the same thing?
faq.a: Most simple patterns repeat the same group of items over and over again. This is how we find what comes next.
asks: Is it always the same order?
Does it have to be the same shape?

faq.q: What if the pattern is tricky?
faq.a: Look closely at the first few items. Find the part that repeats.
asks: How do I solve a hard pattern?

faq.q: Can I use numbers in patterns?
faq.a: Yes, numbers make patterns too. For example, counting up by two: two, four, six, eight.

faq.q: Do shapes have to be perfect?
faq.a: For simple patterns, we use clear shapes like circles and squares. You can use any shape you like to make a pattern.
asks: Do the shapes have to be neat?

facts: Patterns are things that repeat in a predictable way.
You can find patterns in nature, like the rings of a tree.
Patterns can use colours, shapes, or numbers.
To find what comes next, you must find the pattern rule first.

quiz.say: Look at the pattern. What colour comes next?
quiz.why: The pattern repeats red, blue. After blue comes red.

wrong.1: Blue came last, so the pattern goes back to red.
wrong.2: Green is a new colour, and this pattern uses only red and blue.

quiz.say: Look at the pattern. What shape comes next?
quiz.why: The pattern repeats circle, square. After square comes circle.

wrong.0: Square came last, so the pattern goes back to circle.
wrong.1: A triangle is a new shape, and this pattern uses circles and squares.

quiz.say: Look at the pattern. What comes next?
quiz.why: The pattern repeats clap, stamp. After stamp comes clap.

wrong.0: Stamp came last, so the pattern goes back to clap.
wrong.2: Wave is a new action, and this pattern uses clap and stamp.
